title: rewrite a merged change as a reviewer sentence
provenance: The squash-commit description of a real merged change, omniintelligence 0501a4c7945db757a0e13e13ab22ce5f5cfa1ed7.
prompt:
Rewrite this merged change's description as a one-sentence summary a reviewer can read in five seconds. Keep the ticket identifier OMN-19766 and the name `github.job_workflow_sha` exactly as written. Add nothing the description does not state. At most 35 words.

CHANGE (omniintelligence#953):
ci(OMN-19766): re-pin the public-repo hygiene caller to omniclaude 6ccd525e2

* ci(OMN-19766): re-pin the public-repo hygiene caller to omniclaude 6ccd525e2

The old pin's reusable checked its validator out at
`inputs.validator_ref || github.job_workflow_sha`. `github.job_workflow_sha`
is not a context, so the ref resolved empty and actions/checkout fetched
omniclaude `dev`. From omniclaude#2373 (19:49Z) that dev script required a lab
vocabulary the old reusable never fetched, and the gate exited 2 on every run.

omniclaude 6ccd525e2 carries both halves of the fix: the validator checkout
uses a validated `job.workflow_sha`, fails closed when it is empty or not a
40-hex commit, and asserts HEAD (OMN-16726, omniclaude#2366); and the reusable
fetches the lab vocabulary so the lab-config class is evaluated (OMN-19766,
omniclaude#2373, #2375). The workflow and the script now come from one pin.

The header comment named the non-existent context; it now names the one the
reusable actually uses.

Onex-Lane: overlays-lo16-lo18-83
Onex-Session: 813eeeb5e1a24315afef78f6c460ff64

* ci(OMN-19766): re-pin two stale reusable callers to omniclaude 6ccd525e2

kb-doc-gate.yml and secrets-baseline-wiring.yml were both still pinned to
33af26309b (2026-09-21), which predates omniclaude#2366 (667fc8dcc) and
its self-checkout fix. Re-pin both to 6ccd525e2.

Validated: both reusables at 6ccd525e2 fail closed on a non-40-hex or
mismatched checkout sha, and running each validator locally against this
tree (kb_doc_gate.py --base-ref origin/dev --mode diff;
secrets_baseline_wiring_gate.py --repo-root .) exits 0 before and after.

FRICTION against OMN-16726 (hygiene-pin-fix-83, 2026-09-26T23:16:09Z).

Onex-Lane: overlays-lo16-lo18-83
Onex-Session: 813eeeb5e1a24315afef78f6c460ff64

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
